player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi kpɛlɛɛ {player_id} le Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma mɛ tɛ {num_rounds} kpɛlɛɛ.

Ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ:
- Pɩnzɩ pɩnzɩ ɛyʊʊ mbʊ ɛyʊʊ {total_conversation_rounds} tɛtɛ kpɛlɛɛ nɛ ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ.
- Pʊʊ ɛyʊʊ, pɩnzɩ ɩnʊʊ ɛyʊʊ nɛ ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ [Cooperate] bee [Defect] (pʊʊ-kɔɔ pɔzɩ).

Payoff Matrix (kpɛlɛɛ kpɛlɛɛ):
- Pɩnzɩ ɩnʊʊ Cooperate ➜ ɛyʊʊ {cooperate_reward}
- Pɩnzɩ ɩnʊʊ Defect ➜ ɛyʊʊ {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ɛyʊʊ Defects, ɛyʊʊ Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ:
- Ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ tɛtɛ: tɔɔ ɛyʊʊ mbʊ ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ.
- Ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ tɛtɛ: tɔɔ '[Cooperate]' bee '[Defect]' (pʊʊ-kɔɔ pɔzɩ). Ɛyʊʊ pɔzɩ mbʊ ɛyʊʊ tɛtɛ pɩnzɩ/pʊʊ token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kɔvɛrɩsɩ kɩlɩ wayɩ mbʊ yɔ round {round}. Pɩlɩna '[Cooperate]' mbʊ yɔ '[Defect]' ɖɔnɛ ɛzɩma \boxed{{}}.
